questions.question: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile River is approximately 6,650 km long.

questions.question: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.explanation: Vatican City is only 0.44 sq km.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located on the border of which two countries?
questions.explanation: Everest sits on the Nepal-China border.

questions.question: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.explanation: Sahara covers approximately 9.2 million sq km.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was chosen as the capital in 1913.

questions.question: What planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.explanation: H2O means 2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom.

questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire in 322 BC.

questions.question: In which year did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occur?
questions.explanation: It occurred on April 13, 1919 in Amritsar.

questions.question: Who wrote the Indian national anthem?
questions.explanation: Jana Gana Mana was written by Rabindranath Tagore.

questions.question: Which Mughal emperor built the Taj Mahal?
questions.explanation: Shah Jahan built it in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
